name: n8n Form
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the n8n Form node to create user-facing forms with multiple steps. You can add other nodes with custom logic between to process user input. You must start the workflow with the n8n Form Trigger node

parameters.formDescription: This form contains branches, but only one branch will ever be executed.

values.fieldLabel: What can we do to improve?

parameters.content:
## Form with mutually exclusive branching
This form contains a branch where only one of the two paths will execute, depending on your selections.

This Switch node determines which branch will execute.

The switch uses data from a dropdown field with single selection enforced, so only one path will execute.

parameters.formTitle: Form that may execute multiple branches
parameters.formDescription: This form contains multiple branches. Depending on the user's responses, more than one branch may execute sequentially.

values.fieldLabel: What are your favorite film genres

parameters.content:
## Form that may execute multiple branches
This form contains branching where more than one path may execute, depending on the user's selections.

This Switch node determines which branches will execute.

Multiple conditions may be true, resulting in more than one branch being executed. When this happens, n8n executes the first branch completely before returning to execute the next branch.

parameters.content:
n8n Form nodes using the **Form Ending** page type are only executed if they are the last node in the execution path.

These endings specific to a genre are only executed if this is the only valid branch.

The switch includes this **Form Ending** node whenever more than one branch is executed.

Because this is the [final branch](https://docs.n8n.io/flow-logic/execution-order/) that will be executed, this is the final display whenever multiple branches are executed.
